Name: }bedrock.server.backup.create

Parameters.Name: pConnectionName
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Connection name in }bedrock.session.start, or a connection-details JSON object returned by it. If blank, the session.start default connection is used

Parameters.Name: pDatabaseName
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Database to back up. If blank, the database from the connection is used

Parameters.Name: pBackupFileName
Parameters.Prompt: REQUIRED: Backup name without extension (.tgz is added). Must not contain #=:|+?*,;."/\[]&<>`

Parameters.Name: pWaitForComplete
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Wait until the backup appears in the backup list (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pTimeout
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Maximum time to wait for the backup in seconds (Numeric. Default = 1800)

Parameters.Name: pWaitInterval
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Time between backup list checks in seconds (Numeric. Default = 15)

Parameters.Name: pLogOutput
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Write parameters and action summary to server message log (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pStrictErrorHandling
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: On encountering any error, exit with major error status by ProcessQuit after writing to the server message log (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pRunProcessMode
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Set to 1 if the connection's values in }bedrock.session.start are read from a cube (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pJson
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: JSON Object with process parameter values. This will overwrite user passed parameters for all included parameters.
